text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You should use it. It's perfect for when
you need a
break.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
No! You should use it instead! It'll be
great for a
change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I don't require it. Besides, it's not
appropriate for
a trainer to accept this
from their—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing. Don't ask any
questions—just
take this!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: W-wait! Bitter Glasse!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What she so forcefully gives us is a
coupon to
visit a tourist farm.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
She apparently got it while out
shopping. I told
her that I didn't need it,
but she wouldn't relent...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: What? You mean... go together?
choice_data_list: せっかくだし行きませんか？

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I suppose we shouldn't let it go to
waste.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
This is nice. The view is beautiful around
here,
and the air is crisp and refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The grounds are so large that simply
walking
around feels like it would be
excellent training.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, if only Bitter Glasse hadn't
been so
stubborn. This would've been
the perfect place
for her to relax.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yet she kept insisting that I get a
change of
pace...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If that's true, it's a shortcoming on my
part.
choice_data_list: 疲れているように見えたのでは？

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I have been rather busy lately.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glasse is unexpectedly intuitive,
despite
how she may seem.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I need to improve my stamina so this
doesn't
happen aga—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Wait. Could it be you invited me for
precisely the
same reason?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Then I'll leave it at that.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Let's go for a stroll. Walking with
purpose makes
for good exercise.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what a strange creature. It's staring
right at
me...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Are you making fun of me? Of course I
know what
it's called. It's... an alcapa,
obviously.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Ahem! I knew that. I was just testing you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Is it really safe to be touching that cow?!
What if
it snaps at you?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
V-very well. I'm grateful for everything
that cows
provide us, after all...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Their milk is an important source of
nutrients for
runners, and—

text_block_list.name: Cow
text_block_list.text: Mooooo.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy our day together, slowly
strolling
around the farm and interacting
with all the
animals we meet.
